title: Zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#e8ecf2'/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d='M32 46 Q38 58 33 72' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M43 43 Q49 58 43 75' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M54 42 Q60 58 54 75' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M65 45 Q71 58 66 72' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='31' y='70' width='8' height='22' rx='3' fill='#d5dae3'/>
  <rect x='60' y='70' width='8' height='22' rx='3' fill='#d5dae3'/>
  <rect x='31' y='70' width='8' height='8' fill='#2b2f5c'/>
  <rect x='60' y='70' width='8' height='8' fill='#2b2f5c'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a4f7a'/>
  <rect x='59' y='90' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a4f7a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M70 52 L80 34 L88 38 L78 58 Z' fill='#e8ecf2'/>
  <path d='M76 46 L82 38' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='32' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#e8ecf2'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='93' cy='35' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#c9ced8'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='34' r='1.8' fill='#2b2f5c'/>
  <!-- mouth stripes on head -->
  <path d='M78 26 Q83 32 79 40' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M87 24 Q92 31 87 40' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='29' r='2.2' fill='#2b2f5c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M77 23 L74 14 L82 21 Z' fill='#e8ecf2'/>
  <path d='M78 21 L76 16 L81 20 Z' fill='#c9ced8'/>
  <path d='M89 21 L93 13 L94 22 Z' fill='#e8ecf2'/>
  <path d='M90 20 L92 16 L93 21 Z' fill='#c9ced8'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M72 44 Q68 34 74 26' stroke='#7b81ad' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 55 Q16 58 15 66' stroke='#2b2f5c' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='69' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#2b2f5c'/>
</svg>
